questions.q: Please remember ___ the lights off when you leave the co-working space.
questions.explainRo: **Remember + to + infinitiv** = nu uita să faci ceva (acțiunea urmează).

questions.q: My ___ was so bad that the physiotherapist told me to change my chair and sit up straight.
questions.explainRo: **Posture** = felul în care îți ții corpul; o postură greșită duce la dureri de spate.

questions.q: After six months without a single day off, I really need a week at the seaside to ___.
questions.explainRo: **Recharge your batteries** = a te odihni ca să-ți recapeți energia.

questions.ro: Am reușit să prindem ultimul tren.
questions.explainRo: **Manage** este urmat de **to + infinitiv**: managed to catch.

questions.audio: Mindfulness helps me feel less overwhelmed at work.
answers: Mindfulness helps me feel less overwhelmed at work.
questions.ro: Mindfulness mă ajută să mă simt mai puțin copleșit la muncă.
questions.explainRo: **Overwhelmed** = copleșit; **mindfulness** = atenție conștientă, care reduce stresul.

questions.q: Stop ___ (a amâna) and just send the invoice!
questions.explainRo: **Procrastinate** = a amâna din comoditate; după **stop** (= a nu mai face) folosim **-ing**.

questions.q: If you have any questions about the quote, don't hesitate ___ (contact) me.
questions.explainRo: **Hesitate** este urmat de **to + infinitiv**: don't hesitate to contact me.

questions.q: Accepting the job in Berlin would mean ___ my friends and family behind.
questions.explainRo: **Mean + -ing** = a implica; **mean + to + infinitiv** ar însemna „a avea intenția”.

questions.ro: Ne-am oprit să facem poze cu lacul.
questions.explainRo: **Stop + to + infinitiv** = te oprești ca să faci altceva (aici, poze).

questions.q: Our new CTO doesn't let anyone ___ (deploy) on Friday afternoons.
questions.explainRo: După **let + obiect** folosim infinitivul fără to: let anyone deploy.

questions.q: Try to avoid ___ meetings before 11 a.m. – that's your time for deep work.
questions.explainRo: **Avoid** este urmat mereu de **-ing**: avoid scheduling.

questions.ro: Aștept cu nerăbdare să lucrăm împreună.
answers: I look forward to working with you.
I'm looking forward to working with you.
I am looking forward to working with you.
I look forward to working together.
I'm looking forward to working together.
I am looking forward to working together.
I really look forward to working with you.
I'm really looking forward to working with you.
I can't wait to work with you.
I can't wait to work together.
questions.explainRo: După **look forward to** urmează **-ing** (to e prepoziție): look forward to working, nu „to work”.
